The list that names this phone\'s keys is encrypted with a hardware key this phone no longer has, for example after a restore or a security reset. Protected items stay safe and your other devices are unaffected. Reset the list, then enrol this phone\'s keys again under Settings, then Keys.
Key list reset. Enrol this phone\'s keys again.
